pages.title: White Widow
pages.text: $(bold)Base THC:$() 15% — $(bold)Base CBD:$() 10%$(br)$(bold)Effect:$() Wind Charged (10 seconds)$(br)$(bold)Extra Effects:$() None (THC ≤ 20)$(br)$(br)A balanced starter strain. White Widow seeds can drop as loot from $(bold)Trial Chambers$() — making it one of the few strains obtainable before building machines.$(br)$(br)$(bold)Synthesizer Reagents:$()$(br)Bone Meal + Sugar + White Dye
Grind White Widow Buds in the Grinder (2 weed) or Manual Grinder (1 weed). Consume with a Bong, Joint, or Blunt.
Plant on farmland or in a Grow Pot. Grow to age 10 to harvest buds. Also found in Trial Chamber loot.
Pack weed into a bag for selling to the Stoner Villager or compact storage.
